items.title: Citi Forecasts Widening Memory Chip Shortages Through 2031 as AI Demand Expands
items.summary: Citi expects shortages across the global memory semiconductor market to deepen through 2031, driven by increasing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM and NAND as artificial intelligence systems adopt continual learning. In a research note published Monday, the investment bank identified continual learning as a potential central theme in AI development over the next five years.

items.title: Health Catalyst (HCAT) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Cut Targets On Growth Risks
items.summary: Health Catalyst is back in focus after analysts revised fair value from about US$2.10 to roughly US$1.83 per share, which points to a more cautious stance on the stock. Recent research has shifted from earlier optimism with price targets in the US$2 to US$3 range to current levels closer to US$1.80, as analysts weigh execution risks around churn, divestitures and the durability of growth in its health technology offerings.
